title: USTP OJT Evaluation Sheet (BSIT)
description: Based on the supplied USTP OJT Evaluation Sheet, FM-USTP-ReO-014, Rev. 00, effective date printed as 10.01.21. Award points up to each displayed maximum, total 100. PASSED: 91-100; NEEDS IMPROVEMENT: below 91. The source overlaps at 91; this form treats 91 as PASSED. Attendance, cleanliness, and grooming each use a shared category score because the source does not allocate separate points to their two checks. Supervisor feedback belongs in Comments & Feedback. Trainee, company, and training details come from the assigned student record. No handwritten scores or personal details from the sample are included.

criteria.label: Ability to convey ideas and opinions orally
Regular and punctual in attending work as scheduled; proper observance of break periods
Maintains cleanliness and orderliness of the working area; systematically organizes tasks
Wears appropriate attire; uses safety gear
